<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant background job worker with Redis-backed caching layer.
 * Processes queued jobs for different tenants with strict isolation.
 */

class TenantContext {
    private string $tenantId;
    private string $cachePrefix;
    
    public function __construct(string $tenantId) {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-z0-9\-]{3,36}$/', $tenantId)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid tenant ID format');
        }
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
        $this->cachePrefix = 'tenant:' . $tenantId;
    }
    
    public function getTenantId(): string { return $this->tenantId; }
    public function getCachePrefix(): string { return $this->cachePrefix; }
}

class CacheManager {
    private $redis;
    private ?TenantContext $context = null;
    private array $writeBuffer = [];
    private int $bufferFlushThreshold = 50;
    
    public function __construct($redis) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
    }
    
    public function setContext(TenantContext $context): void {
        $this->context = $context;
    }
    
    public function getContext(): ?TenantContext {
        return $this->context;
    }
    
    private function buildKey(string $key): string {
        if ($this->context === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('No tenant context set');
        }
        return $this->context->getCachePrefix() . ':' . $key;
    }
    
    public function get(string $key): ?string {
        $fullKey = $this->buildKey($key);
        $value = $this->redis->get($fullKey);
        return $value !== false ? $value : null;
    }
    
    public function set(string $key, string $value, int $ttl = 3600): void {
        $fullKey = $this->buildKey($key);
        $this->writeBuffer[] = ['key' => $fullKey, 'value' => $value, 'ttl' => $ttl];
        
        if (count($this->writeBuffer) >= $this->bufferFlushThreshold) {
            $this->flushBuffer();
        }
    }
    
    public function flushBuffer(): void {
        $pipe = $this->redis->pipeline();
        foreach ($this->writeBuffer as $entry) {
            $pipe->setex($entry['key'], $entry['ttl'], $entry['value']);
        }
        $pipe->execute();
        $this->writeBuffer = [];
    }
    
    public function invalidatePattern(string $pattern): int {
        $fullPattern = $this->buildKey($pattern);
        $keys = $this->redis->keys($fullPattern);
        if (!empty($keys)) {
            return $this->redis->del($keys);
        }
        return 0;
    }
}

class JobProcessor {
    private CacheManager $cache;
    private $logger;
    
    public function __construct(CacheManager $cache, $logger) {
        $this->cache = $cache;
        $this->logger = $logger;
    }
    
    public function processJob(array $job): bool {
        $tenantId = $job['tenant_id'] ?? null;
        $jobType = $job['type'] ?? null;
        $payload = $job['payload'] ?? [];
        
        if (!$tenantId || !$jobType) {
            $this->logger->error('Invalid job structure', $job);
            return false;
        }
        
        $context = new TenantContext($tenantId);
        $this->cache->setContext($context);
        
        try {
            return match($jobType) {
                'compute_report' => $this->handleComputeReport($payload),
                'update_settings' => $this->handleUpdateSettings($payload),
                'sync_external' => $this->handleSyncExternal($payload),
                default => false,
            };
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $this->logger->error('Job failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    private function handleComputeReport(array $payload): bool {
        $reportId = $payload['report_id'] ?? '';
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{1,64}$/', $reportId)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $cacheKey = 'reports:' . $reportId;
        $cached = $this->cache->get($cacheKey);
        
        if ($cached !== null) {
            return true; // Already computed
        }
        
        // Simulate expensive computation
        $result = $this->computeReportData($reportId);
        $this->cache->set($cacheKey, json_encode($result), 7200);
        
        return true;
    }
    
    private function handleUpdateSettings(array $payload): bool {
        $settingsKey = 'settings:global';
        $newSettings = json_encode($payload);
        $this->cache->set($settingsKey, $newSettings, 86400);
        return true;
    }
    
    private function handleSyncExternal(array $payload): bool {
        $source = $payload['source'] ?? '';
        if (!in_array($source, ['crm', 'erp', 'analytics'], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $data = $this->fetchExternalData($source);
        $this->cache->set('external:' . $source, json_encode($data), 1800);
        return true;
    }
    
    private function computeReportData(string $reportId): array {
        return ['id' => $reportId, 'generated_at' => time(), 'data' => []];
    }
    
    private function fetchExternalData(string $source): array {
        return ['source' => $source, 'synced_at' => time()];
    }
}

class BackgroundWorker {
    private JobProcessor $processor;
    private $redis;
    private $logger;
    private CacheManager $cache;
    
    public function __construct($redis, $logger) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->logger = $logger;
        $this->cache = new CacheManager($redis);
        $this->processor = new JobProcessor($this->cache, $logger);
    }
    
    public function run(): void {
        $this->logger->info('Worker started');
        
        while (true) {
            $rawJob = $this->redis->brpop('job_queue', 5);
            if ($rawJob === null) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $jobs = $this->expandJob($rawJob[1]);
            
            foreach ($jobs as $job) {
                $this->processor->processJob($job);
            }
            
            // Flush any remaining buffered writes after batch
            $this->cache->flushBuffer();
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Expand a job payload - supports batch jobs containing multiple sub-jobs
     * for efficiency. Each sub-job may target a different tenant.
     */
    private function expandJob(string $rawPayload): array {
        $decoded = json_decode($rawPayload, true);
        if ($decoded === null) {
            return [];
        }
        
        if (isset($decoded['batch']) && is_array($decoded['batch'])) {
            return $decoded['batch'];
        }
        
        return [$decoded];
    }
}
